overview: Based on the published agenda, this revised special Village Board meeting was scheduled to convene in closed session to address specific personnel matters, including concerns regarding a former employee and a current employment issue. The board was set to consider possible action following the closed session discussion.

agenda.item: Closed session pursuant to Wisconsin Statutes s. 19.85(1)(c) and s. 19.85(1)(f) to consider specific concerns regarding a former employee and a current personnel employment issue and possible action to address the same

discussions.body: The board was scheduled to convene in closed session to discuss specific concerns regarding a former employee and a current personnel employment issue under Wisconsin's personnel privacy statutes. Possible action was set to be considered during this closed session discussion.

actionItems: Expected to consider possible action regarding former employee and current personnel employment issue during closed session
Scheduled to reconvene in open session and consider any action arising from closed session
title: REVISED Special Village Board Meeting - 2026-08-18
